title: Custom Blast Furnace
description: A Paper Plugin to allow ANYTHING to be cooked in a blast furnace. (Configurable)
body:
A simple Plugin to allow **ANYTHING** to be cooked in a blast furnace **(Configurable)**.

Config allows for individual Items. Or just all items In general, Or whatever you want.

**This plugin was AI generated (I dont know java yet, and I dont want to get into java)**
